title: Movement Commands for Basic Locomotion (Forward, Backward,  Left and Right turning, etc.)
body:
Hello DeepRoboticsLab team,

I'm looking for documentation on movement commands for basic locomotion.

Are there built-in movement commands for basic locomotion like:
   - Forward/Backward movement
   - Left/Right turning
   - Sidestepping (strafe)
   - Walking gaits (trot, walk, etc.)

If not built-in, what's the recommended approach for implementing movement:
   - Should I create custom gait patterns using direct joint control?
   - Are there example implementations or templates for walking gaits?
   - What are the recommended joint angle sequences for basic movement?

Thank you for your time and any guidance you can provide!

title: Keyboard example not working
body:
The keyboard example does not work as stated in the documentation

Compiled on Lite3 with ROS Noetic with catkin_make (gcc/g++ aarch64)

Commands
```bash
roscore
rosrun examples example_keyboard
```

The CLI shows the controls (WASD to move, U to stand up/sit down etc.) but no input is being translated for movement. Tried through the ssh interface and directly plugging in a keyboard to the Lite3 terminal

The keyboard input seems to have been registered by example_keyboard, but the input doesn't seem to be translated to Lite3 as movement commands
